_meta.comment: SOURCE catalog — English is authored here and is the fallback for every other locale (FR-I18N-2). Keys are namespaced by surface. Every other messages/<locale>.json mirrors this key tree; the key-parity test fails the build on drift. ICU message syntax (https://formatjs.io/docs/core-concepts/icu-syntax). Never translate: CAP/EDXL enum tokens, identifiers, units of record.

app.title: BEACON — Common Operating Picture
app.description: Open-source, local-first near-real-time COP for wildfires and floods.
app.noLiveIncidentsTitle: No live incident in this region
app.noLiveIncidentsDescription: No live source is reporting a wildfire or flood here right now. The map shows what live sources serve; nothing is invented. Sources and their status are listed under Sources.
app.noLiveIncidentsDemoDescription: No live source is reporting a wildfire or flood here right now. The incident shown is the seeded demo scenario, kept for the walkthrough; live layers are drawn as sources serve them.

commandPalette.placeholder: Jump to a region, incident, panel — or act…

decision.humanApprovalRequired: Human approval is required before any public action.
decision.noDraftToApprove: Nothing to approve right now — no draft alert is awaiting review.
decision.roleRequiredToApprove: Sign in as a Verifier or Emergency Manager to approve.

map.unavailableDescription: WebGL isn’t available here. All map data is listed below as an accessible alternative.

caveat.fire: FIRMS hotspots are thermal detections, not confirmed fire perimeters.
caveat.floodzone: Regulatory flood zones — not a live extent
caveat.weather: Observation point — not a forecast grid
caveat.camera: Live cameras — opens the source's site in a new tab
caveat.outage: County-granular (EAGLE-I): areas are assumed-offline estimates, not confirmed per-address outages.
caveat.cell: OpenCelliD-derived coverage estimate — indicative, not a guaranteed signal map.
caveat.storm: Agency cyclone product drawn verbatim — BEACON does not model storm tracks, winds or surge.
caveat.routeDirect: Direct path — this route was not verified to avoid the hazard. Confirm it before sending anyone.

list.empty: No map features in the current view.
list.caption: Accessible list of all map features — the keyboard alternative to the interactive map.

storm.trackLabel: Cyclone centre track — advisory, not an impact area
storm.coneLabel: Forecast cone — track-centre uncertainty, not an impact area
storm.surgeLabel: Storm-surge extent — impact area, included in exposure
storm.coneCaveat: Forecast cone from {agency}, advisory {advisoryAt} — shows where the storm centre may track, NOT the extent of hazardous conditions.
storm.coneCaveatUnattributed: Forecast cone shows where the storm centre may track — NOT the extent of hazardous conditions.

map.offlineBasemap: No basemap in this air-gapped deployment. Every operational layer below is unaffected.
map.unavailableBasemap: No basemap: no tile service is reachable. Every operational layer below is unaffected.

anticipatory.title: Anticipatory action
anticipatory.members: {over, number} of {total, number} forecast members over {threshold, number} {unit}
anticipatory.leadTime: {hours, number} h, as stated by the source. BEACON does not model hazard travel time.
anticipatory.stageGate: Gate: at least {fraction, number} of forecast members over {threshold, number} {unit}, class {klass} or higher, within {hours, number} h lead time.
anticipatory.noEmission: Suggestions only. Nothing on this panel dispatches a resource or emits a public alert; a named human must approve every early action.
anticipatory.stopMechanism: Stop mechanism: {role} may stop the activation on a pre-agreed condition, and the engine stops it automatically after {hours, number} h.
anticipatory.replay: Fixture-fed replay: each recorded forecast run is re-evaluated {lag, number} h after the issue instant stated in the file. Not live data — BEACON queries no ensemble product at runtime.
anticipatory.noProtocolTitle: No early action protocol for this region
anticipatory.noProtocolBody: BEACON ships no early action protocol whose scope names this region, so there is nothing to evaluate. Protocols are configuration (config/eap/), not code.
anticipatory.noForecastTitle: No recorded forecast for this protocol
anticipatory.noForecastBody: The protocol ships, but no recorded forecast file ships with it, so no evaluation can be replayed. BEACON has no wired live ensemble source.
anticipatory.engineRefusedTitle: The anticipatory engine refused this input
anticipatory.engineRefusedBody: The engine refused the input rather than showing a partial evaluation.

routingPanel.noSheltersDescription: No shelters in range for this origin.
routingPanel.avoidsHazard: Route avoids the incident hazard area.
routingPanel.heuristicFallback: Direct path only — the hazard area could not be avoided (heuristic fallback). Treat with caution.

verifierQueue.title: Verification queue
verifierQueue.decisionFailed: Decision failed — the report was not updated. Try again.
verifierQueue.noClaim: No claim recorded (report predates text retention)
verifierQueue.liveFeedCaption: Unverified citizen stream, not an agency camera — a verifier can reject this report to delist it.
verifierQueue.liveFeedExpiredCaption: This unofficial live link has passed its ~2h window. Reject the report to delist it (Art. XIII HITL).
verifierQueue.visionCaption: Advisory only — informs the human record, never auto-decides (Art. XIII HITL).
verifierQueue.visionToggle: Vision check (advisory — recorded satellite fixture; never changes the decision)
verifierQueue.visionLiveToggle: Use live imagery for this report’s location (NASA GIBS, today) instead of the recorded fixture
verifierQueue.rejectTitle: Reject as false / misinformation — no alert is emitted (Art. XIII/XIV)
verifierQueue.rejectCaption: Reject flags a false / misinformation report — it moves to REJECTED with no outbound alert (Art. XIII/XIV).

action.Execute: Carry out the plan you were given for {area} now.
action.Avoid: Stay out of {area}. Do not travel into the area.
action.Monitor: Watch for updates about {area}. Be ready to act if this warning changes.
action.Assess: Check your own situation in {area} and report what you see.
action.AllClear: The danger in {area} has ended. You may go back. Follow local guidance.
action.None: No action is needed in {area} now.
